title: Flatness of a ring map is local on the target
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a ring map. Then $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] if and only if for every prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset S$, with $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$, the induced localization map $R_{\mathfrak p}\to S_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is flat.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00HT (lemma-flat-localization), parts (2) and (6), the flatness local criterion used in More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07C0
